units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:12">Num. R. s. 1</cite>, end <he>שלא יהא ק׳ עליהן</he> that the divine anger be not on them.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVIII; a. fr.—Esp. Ḳetsef name of an angel of destruction.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 17:11">Targ. Y. Num. XVII, 11</cite>, sq.—
Sabb. 55ᵃ (ref. to Ez. IX, 2) ‘six men’, they are ק׳ אף וחימה וכ׳ Ḳ. (Wrath), Af (Anger) &c.
Ex. R. s. 41; a. fr.—2) destruction, harm.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 11:11">Deut. R. s. 11</cite> <he>איך … לעשות לו ק׳</he> how can I do harm to him (Moses)?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 940:27">Yalk. ib. 940</cite>.
